content.title: JUCE LookAndFeel Customization for Audio Plugins
content.overview: Complete guide to creating custom UIs for audio plugins using JUCE's LookAndFeel system.

getting_started.description: The LookAndFeel class allows complete customization of JUCE component appearance
capabilities: Customize drawing of controls (buttons, sliders, etc.)
Apply different styles to different components

step_1.important_note: Always declare LookAndFeel object BEFORE components that use it

step_2.description: Apply custom look and feel to entire editor or specific components

performance_considerations.title: UI Performance Best Practices
guidelines: Cache paths and gradients that don't change between paint calls
Use juce::Path for complex shapes instead of multiple draw calls
Avoid heavy calculations in paint routines - pre-compute when possible
Consider OpenGL renderer for highly animated UIs
Implement dirty region tracking for efficient updates
